contentBlocks.text: The Vault heavy weights room is built for serious strength work — a dedicated space where you can load up without competing for racks or waiting for bars.
Expect Olympic lifting platforms, plate-loaded machines, and the free weights you need for progressive strength, power, and conditioning sessions with your PT.
Because every client trains 1:1, the room stays focused, private, and available when your session needs maximum intensity.

seo.title: Heavy Weights Room | The Vault Private Gym
seo.description: Train heavy in The Vault dedicated strength room with Olympic platforms, plate-loaded machines, and serious iron in a private PT-only environment.
